reviewer_role: Independent of production wrapper and reused helper authorship; no production/helper imports or calls.
boundary: Numerical verification of a post-hoc exposed-DEV descriptive decomposition, conditional on frozen fits, action banks, checkpoints and panels; not independent data or multiplicity-controlled confirmation. Group labels are explanatory, not deployable routing inputs.
